name: bare-linux
description: Example of embedding Bare in a Linux application

scripts.fetch: curl -fsSL https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-kit/releases/download/v2.3.0/prebuilds.zip -o prebuilds.zip && mkdir -p app/lib && unzip -o -j prebuilds.zip linux/$(node -p process.arch)/libbare-kit.so -d app/lib
scripts.bundle: npm run link && npm run pack

author: Holepunch
